lines.text: Raat ke 12 baje, ek customer ne message kiya… aur aap so rahe the.
Subah tak, woh customer aapke competitor ke paas ja chuka tha.
Ye 5 AI automations, har business ko aaj hi lagani chahiye.
Customer kabhi bhi message kare, AI turant sahi jawab deta hai. 24 ghante, saaton din.
Ad se lead aayi? System khud WhatsApp aur email par follow-up karta hai, jab tak woh jawab na de.
Customer chat mein hi slot chune, booking confirm, aur reminder bhi automatic.
Har khush customer ko apne aap message jaata hai, aur aapke Google reviews badhte rehte hain.
Order aaya, bill bana, aur payment link seedhe WhatsApp par. Bina haath lagaye.
Aap business chalao. Baaki kaam, AI karega.
Apne business ke liye free automation plan chahiye? Comment karo, AUTOMATE.
Aur aise hi systems ke liye, Neuraxine ko abhi follow karo.
